title: Job result (connector protocol 1.1)
description: A component's answer to one job, which Knovas Link passes on unchanged. Closed: it holds codes, counts, versions, hashes and one reference, never text. A fetch's bytes arrive as numbered parts before it.

code.description: A code from codes.json, or a component's own of the same shape; never a sentence.

version.description: The source's version of what was read, or found on a conflict.

bytes_sha256.description: SHA-256 over all parts in order, lower-case hex.

source_ref.description: A string: the address where the source staged an applied write; for GitHub the pull request's URL. Null or absent for every other result.
